name: AppUi::ListToolbar
description: The top of a list page box: the search and the page actions in the box header, the select-all and bulk actions on the left of the controls row and the pager on its right. It only lays out its blocks.

position.description: top (default) draws the header and the controls row; bottom draws only the controls row below the list

search.description: The search in the box header: EzSearch or a saved-search picker

actions.description: Page actions after the search, such as the create button (with AccessControl)

selection.description: The left of the controls row: the select-all checkbox and the bulk action buttons

pager.description: The right of the controls row: the selected count and AppUi::Pager

variants.name: list page
variants.description: Search, create button, bulk actions and pager

variants.name: controls only
variants.description: No header; the selection and the pager

variants.name: bottom
variants.description: position bottom: the selection and the pager below the list
